goal: Give the worker one authoritative owner for the deployment lane — src/lib/config/deployment-lane.ts, resolving RAILWAY_ENVIRONMENT_NAME with precedence over NODE_ENV — so Sentry tags staging events 'staging' (#610) and the production-only boot gates stop being inert on the production Railway worker, where NODE_ENV is unset (#611).
non_goals: Populating any production Railway environment variable. Prod worker env stays owned by the WS8 cutover runbook; this PR performs no Railway writes in any environment.
Deploying the production worker. It has never been deployed and still cannot boot (REDIS_QUEUE_URL, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, ADMIN_NOTIFICATION_EMAIL, SENTRY_DSN all absent).
Touching the Next.js / Vercel lane. isPreviewEnvironment() stays in src/lib/config/flags.ts, src/instrumentation.ts keeps no Sentry `environment`, and VERCEL_TARGET_ENV callers are unchanged.
Changing worker/index.ts:176's Fastify log-level NODE_ENV read — that is a build-verbosity knob, not a lane check, and gets a named exemption in the new CI rule.
Splitting HEALTH_ALERT_MONITOR_SLUG per environment. One slug with per-environment Sentry monitor state is the intended end state.
Any behaviour change to feature flags, the outbox, billing, approval, or escalation paths.
user_visible_behavior: Sentry events and cron check-ins from the staging worker are tagged environment: 'staging' instead of 'production'.
The [boot] 'Worker listening' log gains two fields: deployment_lane and lane_source.
Every production-lane assert's error message names the resolved lane and the variable it came from.

On the production Railway lane (NODE_ENV unset), assertAlertSinkEnv / assertAdminNotificationEmail / assertProductionMockModeEnv / the WORKER_PUBLIC_URL https check / warnMissingProductionEnv now actually run — a correct, deliberate boot failure on an unconfigured environment.
mockSkip() no longer honours MOCK_EXTERNAL_APIS=true on any deployed lane, so the core-infra and Stripe asserts can no longer be skipped there.
A new process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production' comparison added under worker/ fails ci:static-policy.
invariants: The lane NAME resolves by precedence, never by ||: RAILWAY_ENVIRONMENT_NAME wins whenever present. Staging sets both RAILWAY_ENVIRONMENT_NAME=staging and NODE_ENV=production, so a || re-creates #610.
requiresProductionConfig() is the UNION (Railway var present || NODE_ENV === 'production') and is therefore strictly additive: no environment loses a gate it fires today.
isProductionLane() is false on staging, so AccountOffboardingPurgePoller's purge-window override keeps working for the documented staging dry-run.
Dependency direction stays one-way: worker/ imports from src/lib/, never the reverse (invariant #1, ESLint-enforced). The owner therefore lives in src/lib/config/.
The owner is the only place under worker/ that compares NODE_ENV to 'production', apart from worker/index.ts's Fastify log level. CI-enforced.
No Railway environment is mutated by this change.
Invariant #13 holds: no NEXT_PUBLIC_* companion is introduced for the lane.
edge_cases: Staging sets NODE_ENV=production AND RAILWAY_ENVIRONMENT_NAME=staging — precedence must yield 'staging'.
Production sets RAILWAY_ENVIRONMENT_NAME=production and NO NODE_ENV — the case that makes every gate inert today.
Local run with neither variable set — lane is 'development'.
Local run with NODE_ENV=production and no Railway variable — must keep firing the gates it fires today (requiresProductionConfig() true) and must report lane 'production'.
Vitest run with NODE_ENV=test — requiresProductionConfig() false, gates quiet, existing 954-line startup-assertion suite unaffected in its default posture.
Blank/whitespace RAILWAY_ENVIRONMENT_NAME — treated as absent and falls through to NODE_ENV (matches trimmedOrUndefined in replica-identity.ts).

A future Railway environment with an unrecognised name (e.g. an ephemeral PR env) — deploymentLane() passes the raw name through to Sentry, isProductionLane() is false, requiresProductionConfig() is true.
Sentry cron cutover: on deploy, health-alert-poller's stale 'production' environment goes silent and fires one missed check-in before it is deleted.
existing_patterns_to_follow: worker/config/replica-identity.ts — the precedent for reading RAILWAY_* system vars: a named per-variable read (so ci:process-env treats it as a platform indicator), trimmedOrUndefined() normalisation, and a *Fields() helper returning only defined keys for logging. deploymentLaneFields() mirrors replicaIdentityFields() exactly.
src/lib/config/flags.ts — the sibling lane reader (isPreviewEnvironment, VERCEL_TARGET_ENV) and the house style for a small, un-memoized, runtime-agnostic env primitive under src/lib/config/.
scripts/ci/static-policy-audit.ts INLINE_FLAG_ACCESS — the precedent for a 'use the sanctioned reader, not the raw env access' rule with a path allowlist.
worker/index.ts:605-608 — the existing [boot] log call that already spreads replicaIdentityFields(); deploymentLaneFields() is spread alongside it rather than adding a second log line.
worker/config/__tests__/startup-assertion.test.ts — the setEnv/KEYS save-and-restore harness that every new gate test extends.

estimated_diff_size: +460 / -30 (~490 changed lines) across 16 files; revised up from the step-0 estimate of ±250 after grilling added the CI rule, the boot-log/error-message observability, and the two extra call sites
rollback_plan: No schema, no migration, no flag, no Railway write — revert the commit. The only external side effect is the Sentry cron-monitor environment cutover: reverting re-tags staging check-ins as 'production', which the pre-existing monitor environment still accepts, so the monitor self-heals. If the staging worker fails to boot after deploy, the [startup] error names the resolved lane and its source; redeploy the previous Railway deployment per docs/runbooks/rollback.md.
observability: [boot] 'Worker listening' log carries deployment_lane and lane_source — the success proof, read from Railway deploy logs.
Every production-lane assert failure names the resolved lane and the variable it came from — the failure proof, available even when SENTRY_DSN is the thing missing.
Sentry events from the staging worker carry environment: 'staging' — the independent third proof, and the direct fix for #610.
The health-alert-poller cron monitor grows a 'staging' environment receiving check-ins; the stale 'production' environment is deleted as a runbook step after the deploy is verified.
Regression signal: ci:static-policy fails if a hand-spelled NODE_ENV lane check reappears under worker/.
